scope: Aquarium predation visual replay only; no predation rules, economy, saved fish or database changes

webglReplay.environment: Isolated localhost scene.ts replay with synthetic state, no account or persistence

automated.faceAnchorCoverage: 362 face-enabled GLB forms; 19 non-face forms use fallback
automated.resourceChecks: Per-replay materials restore original hooks and shared textures; disposal idempotent

limitations: Representative five-style browser coverage is not a visual approval of every predator/prey pairing.
Existing cephalopod GLBs have shared spine-region arm weights: bounded arm-region flex preserves the mantle. Independent CCD is used only where authored arm chains exist.
This is lightweight real-time choreography, not a fluid or soft-body physics simulation.
